name: What kind of preparation is needed before interior painters arrive?

mainEntity.name: What kind of preparation is needed before interior painters arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before interior painters arrive, you should ideally clear small, valuable, or fragile items from rooms to be painted. While our team will move and protect larger furniture, minimizing clutter helps expedite the process and ensures easier access for our painters. Considering what you may need to access during the painting period, such as specific cupboards or frequently used items, can help you prepare effectively without disrupting your daily routine.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear small items and valuables; our team will move and protect larger furniture, but minimizing clutter helps the process.
